notes.runtimeReach: CreaturePF2e#getReach({action:'interact'|'attack', weapon}) → interact: attributes.reach.base; attack: weapon 'reach' trait → base+5; 'reach-N' trait → N (ignores reach.base mods!); melee NPC item → item.reach; else base. attributes.reach.manipulate also exists (interact checks for loot/merchants).
notes.runtimeWeaponRange: WeaponPF2e#range → {increment, max: increment*6} or {max} from system.maxRange. AdjustStrike(range-increment) and ItemAlteration(range-increment/range-max) mutate system.range during actor prep (prepareStrike) so they ARE reflected (when their predicates/toggles are active).
notes.runtimeSpellRange: SpellPF2e#range parses system.range.value '/^(\d+)-f(?:t|eet)/' → {max}; touch → {max: reach.base}. No rule element alters spell range (no ItemAlteration 'range' for spells) — all spell range feats must be applied by range-finder. ItemAlteration 'area-size' (Widen Spell etc.) IS reflected in SpellPF2e#area.
notes.volley: Volley penalty predicate: {lte:['target:distance', N]} and {not:'self:ignore-volley-penalty'} (Point Blank Stance sets that option).
notes.spellshapeToggles: Spellshape feats register RollOption{option:'spellshape', suboptions:[{value:'<slug>'}], placement:'spellcasting'}; when chosen, actor roll options include 'spellshape:<slug>'.
notes.systemActionDefs: game.pf2e.actions (SingleCheckAction) definitions carry no range/distance fields — only slug, statistic, traits, modifiers, notes, variants. Range must come from this catalog.

pf2eHudSkills.identify: map data-item-uuid → action slug (keys differ: 'bonMot', 'treatWounds'); Natural Medicine row uses feat uuid WC4xLBGmBsdOdHWu under data-statistic='nature'

pf2eCharacterSheet.note: Sheet does NOT list generic skill actions (Demoralize etc.) unless the actor owns an action item.
